title: Business Development Executive
description:
Job Description: Business Development Executive 
 Department: Sales & Business Development
 Location: Navi Mumbai
 About Inevia 
Inevia is a manufacturing technology company empowering small and mid-sized manufacturers through smart digital solutions. Our productsincluding Traveler MES, Project Management solutions, and custom software—help manufacturers improve shop-floor visibility, production efficiency, quality, traceability, and operational performance through digital transformation. We are passionate about simplifying manufacturing through innovative software solutions.
 Position Overview 
We are looking for an ambitious and result-oriented Business Development Executive to drive business growth across the assigned territory. Since Inevia is expanding into the Indian market, this role will involve developing new business opportunities, creating brand awareness, building relationships with manufacturing organizations, and contributing to the company's long-term growth strategy.
The ideal candidate should possess strong consultative selling skills, excellent communication abilities, and a passion for technology-driven manufacturing solutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Business Development & Market Expansion Identify new business opportunities across manufacturing industries. Build a strong sales pipeline through cold calling, networking, LinkedIn outreach, email campaigns, referrals, and industry events. Develop relationships with key decision-makers including plant heads, production managers, Operations Heads, IT Managers, Factory Managers, and Business Owners. Generate qualified leads and convert them into sales opportunities. Expand Inevia's presence in assigned territories across India. Conduct market research to identify emerging industries and customer requirements.

 2. Territory Management & Client Engagement Plan and manage daily field visits to maximize customer coverage within the assigned territory. Develop and execute territory-wise sales plans to achieve business objectives. Schedule and conduct regular face-to-face meetings with prospective customers and key stakeholders. Visit manufacturing plants to understand production processes, identify operational challenges, and recommend suitable digital transformation solutions. Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers across customer organizations. Maintain an updated database of prospects and prioritize high-potential accounts for business development. 3. Consultative Sales & Customer Engagement Meet prospective customers to understand their manufacturing processes and operational challenges. Analyze customer pain points and recommend suitable digital transformation solutions. Present Inevia's software portfolio, including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Production Monitoring, Project Management Solutions, and Custom Software Development. Conduct product demonstrations and customer presentations. Work closely with technical teams to prepare customized software solutions based on client requirements. Prepare business proposals, quotations, and solution presentations. 4. Sales Execution & Revenue Generation Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting to successful deal closure. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. Negotiate commercial terms and finalize customer agreements. Maintain accurate sales forecasts and opportunity tracking. Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities. Ensure timely follow-up on all sales opportunities. 5. Customer Relationship Management Build long-term relationships with customers. Act as a trusted advisor throughout the sales journey. Coordinate with implementation and support teams for successful project execution. Conduct regular customer visits and follow-ups. Identify opportunities for repeat business and referrals. Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. 6. Market Intelligence & Business Strategy Track competitor activities, pricing, and market trends. Gather customer feedback to support product enhancements. Participate in exhibitions, trade shows, manufacturing conferences, and networking events. Share market insights with management to support business growth strategies. Contribute ideas for expanding Inevia's product portfolio and service offerings. Required Skills Strong B2B sales and business development skills. Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication abilities. Ability to understand customer business requirements and recommend technology solutions. Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities. Consultative selling approach. Good understanding of industrial manufacturing environments. Self-motivated with strong problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. CRM management skills. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word). Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, Marketing, or a related field. MBA (Marketing,Sales) is an added advantage. Preferred Experience 3–6 years of experience in B2B Sales or Business Development. Experience selling any of the following is highly preferred: Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) ERP Solutions Industrial Software SaaS Products Automation Solutions Digital Manufacturing Solutions Enterprise Software IT Solutions for Manufacturing Existing network within manufacturing companies will be an added advantage. Benefits Collaborative and innovative work environment. Room for professional growth and continuous learning. Competitive compensation package.

 Monitor market shifts and adapt strategies to align with emerging opportunities.

 Up-to-date with latest advertising trends and marketing best practices. 
 Education: Bachelors or Masters degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.

title: Executive  / Senior Executive - Sales Administration
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Executive / Sr. Executive - Sales Administration Department: Sales
 Function: Administration
 Industry: Real Estate & Construction
 Location: Andheri West
 Reporting To: Sales Manager / Project Sales Head 
 1. Job Purpose: To provide effective administrative and operational support to the site sales team by managing sales documentation, customer records, booking-related processes, ERP updates, MIS reports, and coordination with internal departments, ensuring smooth and timely execution of sales activities at the project site. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Sales Administration & Coordination Provide day-to-day administrative support to the site sales team. Coordinate with Sales Managers, Sales Executives, Channel Partners and customers for sales-related requirements. Maintain accurate records of enquiries, site visits, bookings, cancellations and customer follow-ups. Coordinate with the Head Office for various sales processes and approvals. Ensure timely completion and submission of sales-related documents. 
 B. Customer & Booking Documentation Assist in preparation and processing of booking forms, customer KYC documents, application forms and other sales documentation. Verify documents for completeness and coordinate with customers for pending documents. Maintain proper physical and digital records of customer documentation. Coordinate with other departments for booking-related documentation and approvals. 
 C. ERP Management Enter and maintain customer and sales data accurately in the company's ERP system. Ensure timely updating of enquiries, site visits, bookings, payments and other sales transactions. Monitor pending activities and coordinate with concerned team members for closure. Maintain data accuracy and confidentiality of customer information. Generate reports from ERP systems as required by the Sales Head. 
 D. Sales MIS & Reporting Prepare daily, weekly and monthly sales MIS reports. Maintain records of: Leads and enquiries Site visits Booking status Cancellation status Customer documentation Channel Partner performance Collection/payment status Pending cases Share regular reports with the Sales Manager / Project Sales Head. Highlight discrepancies, pending documentation and ageing cases to the concerned stakeholders. 
 E. Site Visit & Customer Coordination Support the sales team in managing customer site-visit records. Maintain visitor/site-visit registers and relevant customer information. Coordinate with the site team to ensure required information and documents are available for customers. Assist the sales team in coordinating customer meetings, presentations and property-related documentation. Maintain proper records of customer feedback and follow-up requirements. 
 F. Coordination with Internal Departments Coordinate with various departments for smooth processing of sales transactions, including: Finance/Accounts: Payment receipts, outstanding payments, booking-related financial documentation. CRM: Customer data, system updates and process-related issues. Legal: Agreements, documentation and legal queries. Projects/Site Team: Unit availability, specifications, possession-related information and site coordination. Marketing: Brochures, price lists, promotional material and campaign-related requirements. Customer Relationship Management: Customer communication and post-booking requirements. 
 G. Channel Partner / Broker Administration Maintain records of registered Channel Partners / Brokers. Assist in processing Channel Partner-related documentation. Maintain records of leads and bookings generated through Channel Partners. Coordinate with the sales team and Finance/Accounts for commission-related documentation and status. Ensure proper documentation for Channel Partner transactions. 
 H. Office & Record Management Maintain organized physical and electronic filing systems at the project sales office. Ensure availability of updated price lists, inventory details, forms and sales-related documents. Maintain confidentiality of customer and company information. Ensure proper control and custody of sales documents and records. Support audits and internal reviews by providing required documentation. 
 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Sales Data Accuracy Accuracy and completeness of ERP records Documentation Timely and accurate processing of customer documents MIS Reporting Timely submission of daily/weekly/monthly reports Booking Processing Timely completion of booking documentation Pending Cases Effective tracking and closure of pending documentation Customer Coordination Timely response and coordination for customer requirements Internal Coordination Effective coordination with other departments Record Management Proper maintenance and accessibility of sales records Channel Partner Administration Accuracy of CP records and transaction documentation 
 4. Educational Qualification Graduate in any discipline. Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management or a related field will be preferred. 
 5. Experience 25 years of experience in Real Estates Sales Administration & Coordination, or a similar role. Experience in the Real Estate / Construction industry will be preferred. Candidates with experience in handling site sales offices will have an added advantage. 
 6. Skills & Competencies 
 Technical Skills Good knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint . Experience with ERP systems . Good understanding of sales documentation and MIS reporting. Strong data-entry and documentation skills. Ability to prepare and maintain Excel-based reports. 
 Behavioural Competencies Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Good written and verbal communication. Customer-oriented approach. Ability to work under deadlines. Good organizational and time-management skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple departments. High level of confidentiality and professional integrity. 
 (This role does not involve selling of any property) 
 Regards, Human Resources Shree Naman Group

description:
Preferred Job Opening: Business Development Executive 
 Company: Red-Card Switches & Home Automation Location: Mumbai Employment Type: Full-time, Field-Based 
 About the Company 
 Red-Card is a manufacturer of premium electrical switches, home automation solutions and lighting products. We are looking for an energetic and result-oriented Business Development Executive to expand our dealer network, develop new business opportunities and strengthen the companys presence across Mumbai. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 - Identify and develop new business opportunities in Mumbai’s electrical and building-material markets. - Visit electrical dealers, retailers, distributors and other potential channel partners. - Appoint new dealers and strengthen relationships with existing dealers. - Promote Red-Card switches, home automation and lighting products. - Generate leads through market visits, references, networking and industry contacts. - Build relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors, builders and project consultants. - Conduct product presentations and explain product features, pricing, schemes and business benefits. - Follow up on enquiries, quotations and potential orders. - Work closely with the sales and technical teams to convert leads into business. - Achieve monthly targets for sales, dealer appointments and revenue growth. - Monitor competitor products, pricing and activities in the market. - Maintain daily records of visits, leads, follow-ups and conversions. - Represent the company at dealer meetings, exhibitions and promotional events when required.

 - Minimum qualification: Graduate preferred. - One to three years of experience in business development, field sales or channel sales is preferred. - Experience in electrical products, modular switches, lighting, home automation, hardware or building materials will be an advantage. - Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills. - Good knowledge of Mumbai’s dealer and project markets. - Ability to develop professional relationships and independently follow up with prospects. - Target-oriented, confident and willing to travel extensively within Mumbai. - Basic knowledge of WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Excel and sales reporting. - A two-wheeler and valid driving licence are preferred. 
 What We Offer 
 - Competitive salary based on experience. - Attractive performance-linked incentives. - Product and sales training. - Support from the company’s sales and technical teams. - Opportunities for professional growth and higher responsibilities.

title: Senior Sales Associate
description:
Title - Senior Sales Associate 
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level – Areas Operations Manager 
 About Lenskart 
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers’ eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially. 
 About the Role 
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store. 
Responsibilities 
 1) Customer focus 
*Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
*He/she will be involved in stock takes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day
*He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
*He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
 2)Product Recommendation 
*With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
*He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
 3) Achieving sales targets & SOP Adherence 
*Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
*Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse.
 4)Store upkeep &Maintenance 
*He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
*He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
 Personal attributes & competencies 
*Minimum qualification: Graduation
*Minimum Experience- 2-year experience in any sales (Except tele-sales)
*Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
*Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
*Clear articulation and active listening skills
*Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
*Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

title: India - Sales Manager
description:
Who are Inchcape 
 At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations. 
 
 We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry. 
 
 Main Purpose of Job : Working in a matrix structure and as a member of the Commercial team, the Commercial Manager, India is responsible for growing revenue from the customer base of India. 
 Duties and Responsibilities : 
 Build an understanding of our customers by: - Leveraging industry insights to ensure focus on the customer and how we add value to their business. Ensuring every customer is visited at least every quarter. Ensuring customers are made aware of Inchcape s Products and Services by introducing on (yearly) average, more than 1 product at customer visits and/or as further directed in product sales campaigns in Salesforce. Growing pipeline by at least 4 targets through visiting customers and introducing Inchcape s Products and Services. Create meaningful connections with customers by: - Ensuring alignment between Customers and Inchcape through discipline, transparency, and support across Inchcape s organization. Achieving a win rate of at least 25% Ensuring every customer is retained by selling, on (yearly) average, more than 1 product to owned customers. 
 Ensure Inchcape gets paid fairly and timely by: - Negotiating terms and conditions with customers which support the development of profitable business that achieves or exceeds Inchcape s contracting principles. Leveraging Commercial Policies and Processes on pricing, bids and tenders, contract negotiations, etc., to guarantee compliant execution. Communicate pricing initiatives with customers and ensure Inchcape is at the forefront of providing value to customers. Support the Inchcape Accounts Receivable to collect fees on time, or as escalated for overdue payments. 
 Knowledge : Knowledge of shipping, preferably vessel operations Graduate with reasonable knowledge of IT 
 Skills Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills. Excellent negotiation and influencing abilities. Effective presentation and communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to prioritize workload and manage competing deadlines effectively. 
 
 Experience Master Mariner qualification preferred, with strong understanding of vessel operations, port requirements, and stakeholder expectations. Strong network and relationships with ship owners, operators, charterers, and maritime stakeholders. Ability to confidently represent the organization and promote agency services to potential clients. 
 Qualification Relevant academic qualification - required MBA or higher learning within the Shipping Industry - desirable Multiple languages - desirable 
 Other requirements Ability to travel within India. In exceptional/rare situations, there may be a requirement to travel out of India also. Working knowledge of common IT systems 
 Character and personal qualities : Inchcape s Clarified Personality Assertive, point the way, provide solutions and lead by example Articulate, share expertise, knowledge and opinions with passion and precision Uncomplicated, smooth and efficient service 
 Personal Characteristics Resilience - works well under pressure Social Poise - strong in front of an audience Connects quickly and is comfortable with new people Target Driven Collaborative 
 
 Why Inchcape Shipping Services We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry. 
 Our values are at the cente of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these: Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture. 
 The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships. 
 Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry. 
 In return, we will offer you: A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive: - A retirement savings plan - Life assurance - Holiday - Competitive salary - Employee Assistance Programme - Career development and progression opportunities - Values Award celebration events 
 Plus, much more! 
 If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert! 
 #ISSthebiggerpicture 
 Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location. 
 Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

title: Chief Sales Manager
description:
JOB SUMMARY 
 
Chief Manager Sales will be responsible for driving Order Booking, Revenue Growth, Customer Engagement, and overall business development for the region. The incumbent will own the complete Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle, build strategic customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver profitable growth. 
 Key Result Areas: 
 Business Growth & Sales 
 Deliver annual and quarterly Order Booking (OB), Revenue and Gross Margin targets for the Western Region. Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with the company's business objectives. Identify and convert new business opportunities across Utilities, EPC Contractors, Renewable Energy, Metro Rail, Railways, Data Centers, Industries and Infrastructure sectors. Drive market penetration for MV, HV and EHV Power Cable solutions. Customer Relationship Management 
 Build and nurture long-term relationships with key decision-makers across: State & Private Transmission Utilities Distribution Utilities EPC Contractors Renewable Energy Developers Metro Rail Corporations Industrial & Infrastructure Customers Consultants and Project Developers Engage with CXOs, procurement teams, consultants and project execution teams to enhance customer satisfaction and increase wallet share. Position Sterlite Electric as the preferred partner for strategic projects. End-to-End Order-to-Cash (O2C) Ownership 
 Own the complete sales lifecycle from opportunity identification to final payment realization. Lead customer qualification, solution selling, techno-commercial discussions and negotiations. Coordinate with Tendering, SCM, Engineering, Projects, Finance, Legal and Commercial teams to ensure seamless order execution. Monitor order execution, dispatches, billing, payment milestones and collections. Drive timely receivable collections and ensure healthy cash flow and working capital management. Tendering & Commercial Excellence 
 Lead strategic bidding decisions and pricing discussions. Review commercial risks, contractual terms and bid strategies. Support preparation of competitive techno-commercial proposals. Participate in customer negotiations and contract finalization. Market Intelligence & Business Development 
 Track upcoming projects, government investments and market trends. Monitor competitors, pricing strategies and emerging business opportunities. Develop account growth plans for strategic customers. Identify opportunities for cross-selling and new product introductions. Cross-Functional Leadership 
 Work closely with Product Management, Tendering, Engineering, SCM, Projects and Finance teams. Ensure timely internal approvals and customer clearances. Drive collaboration to improve conversion ratio, execution efficiency and customer experience. Reporting & Governance 
 Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and forecast. Review regional business performance periodically. Ensure compliance with company policies, governance and ethical business practices. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Achievement of Order Booking (OB) Targets Revenue Achievement Gross Margin Achievement Sales Pipeline Development and Conversion Customer Acquisition & Key Account Growth Tender Success Rate Timely Completion of Order-to-Cash (O2C) Cycle Receivable Collections & Reduction in Outstanding Debtors FCFO Contribution through Improved Collections Customer Satisfaction & Relationship Development Market Share Growth across Western India Preferred Experience 
 15-18 years of experience in Sales, Business Development or Key Account Management within the Power, Electrical or Infrastructure sectors. Strong exposure to HV/EHV Power Cables, Conductors, Electrical Equipment, EPC or Transmission & Distribution businesses. Experience working with Utilities, EPC Contractors, Renewable Energy Developers, Metro Rail Projects or Industrial customers. Proven track record of achieving large order booking and revenue targets. Experience in managing strategic customer relationships and large-value commercial negotiations. 
 Educational Qualification 
 Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (preferred). Engineering graduates with relevant industry experience may also be considered. MBA in Marketing or Business Management will be an added advantage. 
 Key Competencies 
 Strategic Sales & Business Development Key Account Management Customer Relationship Management Techno-Commercial Negotiation Tendering & Contract Management Financial & Commercial Acumen Market Intelligence Leadership & Team Collaboration Analytical Thinking Influencing & Stakeholder Management Results Orientation Strong Communication & Presentation Skills

title: Assistant General Manager Sales And Business Development
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 The candidate will be responsible for driving API business development, identifying new customers and business opportunities, managing key accounts, developing strategic partnerships, and achieving sales and revenue targets across Europe and other international markets. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute sales and business development strategies for Pharmaceutical APIs in European and international markets. Identify, target, and develop new customers, distributors, pharmaceutical companies, CDMOs and strategic partners across Europe. Manage and strengthen relationships with existing API customers and key accounts. Generate new business opportunities through market research, customer mapping, industry networking, conferences, exhibitions and direct customer engagement. Understand customer requirements related to API products, regulatory requirements, technical documentation, quality standards and commercial expectations . Drive the complete business development cycle from lead generation and customer qualification to quotation, negotiation, contract finalization and order closure . Prepare and negotiate commercial proposals, pricing, supply agreements, contracts and long-term business arrangements in coordination with internal teams. Work closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Finance teams to ensure successful customer onboarding and business execution. Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective customers and opportunities in the European market. Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, product demand and regulatory developments affecting the API business. Identify opportunities for new API products, product registrations, alternate sources and strategic product portfolios based on market demand. Participate in international pharmaceutical exhibitions, conferences and customer meetings to develop business relationships. Conduct regular customer visits and business reviews across European markets as required. Support the preparation of product presentations, technical-commercial proposals, customer presentations and market intelligence reports . Ensure achievement of annual sales, revenue, margin and new-business targets . Manage sales forecasts, pipeline reporting and business development MIS. Coordinate with customers regarding product samples, technical documents, audits, qualification, registration and commercial requirements . Support resolution of customer complaints, delivery issues, quality concerns and commercial matters in coordination with relevant internal functions. Build long-term strategic relationships with major pharmaceutical customers and decision-makers. Explore opportunities for contract manufacturing, strategic alliances, licensing, distribution and long-term supply agreements , wherever applicable. 

 Preferred candidate profile Existing network/relationships with European pharmaceutical companies, API buyers, distributors or procurement teams. Experience handling customers across multiple European countries. Understanding of European pharmaceutical procurement and customer qualification processes. Exposure to European regulatory and quality expectations for APIs. Experience in international commercial negotiations and long-term customer development. Willingness and ability to travel internationally for customer meetings, exhibitions and business development activities.

title: Junior Client Servicing / Account Executive
description:
Job Description: Junior Client Servicing / Account Executive 
 Department: Internal Creative / Marketing Agency
 Company: Wockhardt 
 Experience: 02 years 
 Location: Mumbai 
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Reporting To: Account Manager / Client Servicing Lead 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a proactive and organised Junior Client Servicing professional to join Wockhardts internal agency team. The role will be responsible for coordinating with internal stakeholders and creative teams to ensure marketing and communication requirements are clearly understood, effectively executed, and delivered on time. The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in advertising, communication, and brand building, along with excellent coordination and interpersonal skills. This role is suited to someone who enjoys working with multiple stakeholders, managing timelines, and taking ownership of projects from brief to delivery. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Act as the day-to-day point of contact between internal Wockhardt stakeholders and the agency/creative team. Understand client briefs, clarify requirements, and translate them into clear creative briefs for the relevant teams. Coordinate with copywriters, designers, strategists, digital teams, and other agency functions to move projects forward. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while ensuring timelines and deliverables are tracked. Prepare project briefs, timelines, status updates, meeting notes, and follow-up actions. Coordinate feedback and approvals between stakeholders and creative teams. Ensure all communication and creative outputs are aligned with the agreed brief, brand guidelines, and business requirements. Proactively follow up on pending inputs, feedback, approvals, and deliverables. Participate in client meetings and internal discussions and capture actionable next steps. Build strong working relationships with marketing, brand, medical, sales, and other internal teams. Support the team in presentations, campaign development, brand communication, digital assets, events, and other marketing initiatives. Maintain organised records of project briefs, artwork versions, approvals, and final deliverables. Flag potential delays, scope changes, or execution challenges to the Account Manager/Client Servicing Lead at an early stage. 
 Skills & Competencies 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills. Excellent coordination and follow-up abilities. Good organisational and time-management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities. Attention to detail. Ability to understand a brief and communicate it clearly to creative teams. Comfortable working with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders. Good presentation and interpersonal skills. Basic understanding of advertising, branding, social media, and marketing communication. Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel; familiarity with Google Workspace is an advantage. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines. A proactive, problem-solving mindset with a willingness to learn. 
 Qualification 
 Bachelors degree in Marketing, Advertising, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field. 02 years of experience in client servicing, account management, advertising, marketing, or a creative agency environment. Freshers with relevant internships and strong communication/coordination skills may also be considered. 
 Preferred Attributes 
 Prior exposure to pharma, healthcare, FMCG, or other regulated industries is a plus. Interest in creative communication and advertising. Comfortable working with creative professionals and business stakeholders. High ownership and accountability. Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. Ability to balance being client-focused with protecting the quality and feasibility of creative execution. Success in the Role The person in this role will be successful when they can take a brief, get the right people aligned, keep the project moving, manage feedback and approvals, and ensure the final output is delivered accurately and on time. 
 Interested candidates, please share your CV at the email ID mentioned below. RupaliP@wockhardt.com

Job Scope 
 Looking for an experienced Product Sales Support Specialist with strong expertise in Cloud and AI solutions to enable our sales teams and drive business growth. This role involves close collaboration with sales, product, and engineering teams to effectively position and deliver Cloud services (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS) to enterprise customers. The role is highly customer-facing and requires the ability to combine technical knowledge with business understanding to deliver impactful solutions. Total /Relevant Experience 
 10 years + Key Responsibilities

Generate qualified leads and build a strong sales pipeline through direct customer engagement, market outreach, networking, strategic prospecting, and partner engagement Own and drive opportunities from lead generation through closure, contributing directly to revenue growth Engage with enterprise and government customers to understand business requirements and position relevant Cloud and AI solutions Develop and execute account penetration and go-to-market strategies for specialized Cloud and AI products Achieve assigned revenue, business development, and sales targets for the product portfolio Independently manage customer relationships along with sales team and drive sales opportunities throughout the complete sales lifecycle. Work closely with sales teams to accelerate deal closures while simultaneously creating and managing an independent pipeline of opportunities. Identify new markets, industry segments, and strategic opportunities to expand business reach Track market trends, customer requirements, and competitor offerings to enhance product positioning and market adoption Product Sales & Pre-Sales Enablement: Serve as a key link between Product, Sales, Engineering to ensure effective solution positioning Provide pre-sales support including solution design, customer presentations, demonstrations, workshops, Trials and Proof of Concepts (POCs). Assist sales teams in positioning and selling Cloud and AI-based solutions Analyse customer requirements and recommend appropriate solutions including 1. Cloud Infrastructure (Compute, Storage, Networking, Backup, Disaster Recovery, etc.) 2. AI/ML Solutions 3. Data Platforms and Analytics Solutions 4. Digital Transformation Initiatives Prepare technical and commercial proposals, RFP/RFI responses, solution documents, and business cases. Participate in customer engagements, workshops, technical discussions, and solution validation activities Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to align solutions with customer and market requirements Conduct product training and enablement sessions for internal sales teams and partners Contribute to go-to-market strategies, competitive differentiation, and product positioning initiatives. Act as the subject matter expert for Cloud and AI solutions across customer engagements Follow and commit with Yottas Policy statements (e.g. QMS/EMS/OHS/ISMS/ITSM/BCMS/EnMS etc.) Undertake applicable training as communicated from time to time. Understand the organization’s expectations towards all management systems the company is certified for. Participation in Risk assessment process contributes to achieving departmental & management system objectives. Adhere to confidentiality policy to safeguard sensitive company information, maintain trust with clients and partners, and ensure compliance with data protection regulations. Perform their duties in the event of emergency as per roles in ERP/BCMS plan. Assist in maintaining PIMS controls throughout personal data lifecycle. Must-have skill 
 Strong Cloud Computing knowledge (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent). Experience in Enterprise Technology Sales and Business Development. Lead Generation and Pipeline Management Solution Selling and Consultative Sales Proposal Management (RFP/RFI/RFQ). Customer Presentations and Demonstrations. Stakeholder Management. Revenue and Opportunity Management. Excellent Presentation and Communication Skills. Strong Negotiation and Relationship Management Skills Good-to-Have Skills 
 AI/ML Solutions exposure Cloud Migration and Digital Transformation experience. Data Analytics and Big Data understanding. Cybersecurity and Compliance awareness Experience working with System Integrators, Cloud Service Providers, or Data Center organizations. Government and Enterprise Sales experience. Qualifications Criteria 
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering / information technology / computer science or related field. MBA (Marketing / Sales / Technology Management) preferred Certification Criteria 
 AWS Certified Solutions Architect / Cloud Practitioner Microsoft Azure Certifications Google Cloud Certifications. AI / Machine Learning Certifications. Sales and Solution Selling Certifications (Preferred).

- You're looking for a desk job.

title: National Sales Manager - Corporate Hospital
description:
Job Title: National Sales Manager Business Unit: Alternate Trade, GT & Institution Head Job Grade   Location: Mumbai, India         At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine” — by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community. Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?   As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”   Profile Summary:   Sun Pharma is looking for a National Sales Manager (NSM) – Corporate Hospital Business to lead and drive the growth of its Corporate Hospital Business across India.

The role will be responsible for business strategy, market-share growth, key hospital partnerships, institutional sales excellence, portfolio expansion and execution across the national hospital ecosystem. The incumbent will work closely with Sales teams, Marketing, Distribution and other cross-functional teams to build a strong, sustainable and future-ready hospital business.

This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep expertise in the exclusive hospital business, strong commercial acumen and established relationships with senior hospital stakeholders, particularly Procurement, SCM and Purchase leadership.

   Key responsibilities: 
 1. National Business Leadership 

Own and drive the national Corporate Hospital Business, with accountability for growth, profitability, market share and business performance.

Develop and execute annual business plans, forecasts, budgets and growth strategies for the hospital channel.

Identify opportunities for geographical expansion, deeper hospital penetration and business development across Metro, Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.

Track market dynamics, competitive landscape and regional performance, translating insights into actionable business strategies.

Drive sustainable growth through strategic account management and institutional business development.

 2. Corporate Hospital Business 

Lead business development across large corporate hospital chains, standalone hospitals, trust accounts.

Build and strengthen strategic relationships with senior hospital decision-makers and key stakeholders.

Establish strong engagement with hospital SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial leadership.

Drive hospital empanelment, formulary inclusion, explore business opportunities with new brand inclusions.

Develop and manage strategic relationships with key hospital networks and purchasing organisations.

Ensure strong execution of hospital-specific business plans and account strategies.

 3. Strategic Account Management 

Develop a robust Key Account Management framework for top corporate hospital groups and strategic institutions.

Map decision-making structures and build relationships across hospital management, procurement, SCM, Purchase, clinical stakeholders and other influencers.

Identify and unlock new business opportunities within existing and emerging hospital networks.

Drive long-term partnerships with key institutional customers rather than transactional business relationships.

 4. Portfolio Expansion & New Product Launches 

Identify portfolio gaps and market opportunities within the hospital channel.

Work closely with Marketing, distribution and Sales teams to develop a competitive hospital portfolio and channel strategy.

Drive launch excellence and new product availability across key institutions.

Ensure effective product placement, availability and execution within hospitals.

Monitor supply chain performance and proactively address product availability and service challenges.

 5. Team Leadership & Capability Building 

Lead, coach and develop a high-performing national hospital business team comprising regional/zonal and frontline teams.

Build capabilities in institutional selling, strategic account management, hospital access, negotiation and stakeholder engagement.

Establish a strong performance culture with clear objectives, review mechanisms and accountability.

Develop talent and succession capability for the hospital business.

 6. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management
 
Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, Medical, Sales and Digital teams to deliver business objectives.

Drive effective coordination between commercial strategy and operational execution.

Represent the organisation at relevant hospital forums, industry platforms, conferences and strategic customer engagements.

Ensure adherence to company policies, compliance standards and established SOPs.

 7. Digital & Data-Driven Business Excellence 

Drive adoption of CRM, analytics and digital tools across the hospital business.

Use business intelligence and performance dashboards to identify opportunities, track execution and improve productivity.

Build data-led approaches to customer segmentation, account prioritisation, forecasting and business planning.

Identify opportunities for technology-enabled hospital engagement and future-ready business models.


 Travel Estimate 80% Job Requirements Educational Qualification Graduate in Science/Pharmacy; MBA/PGDM preferred. Experience Minimum 10 years of exclusive Pharma Hospital Business experience.

Mandatory minimum 5 years of exclusive Hospital Business experience in a National role or having handled minimum 3 zones out of 4 zones in Pan India leadership role.

Only candidates with exclusive Hospital Business experience should apply.

Well-versed with the top-end corporate hospital ecosystem and senior hospital management.

Established relationships with senior stakeholders in SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial functions of leading hospitals.

Strong understanding of the Indian hospital ecosystem and corporate hospital business models.

Proven track record of delivering business growth, strategic account development and large institutional business Your Success Matters to Us   At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. title: National Sales Manager - Corporate Hospital
description:
Job Title: National Sales Manager Business Unit: Alternate Trade, GT & Institution Head Job Grade   Location: Mumbai, India         At Sun Pharma, we commit to helping you “Create your own sunshine” — by fostering an environment where you grow at every step, take charge of your journey and thrive in a supportive community. Are You Ready to Create Your Own Sunshine?   As you enter the Sun Pharma world, you’ll find yourself becoming ‘Better every day’ through continuous progress. Exhibit self-drive as you ‘Take charge’ and lead with confidence. Additionally, demonstrate a collaborative spirit, knowing that we ‘Thrive together’ and support each other’s journeys.”   Profile Summary:   Sun Pharma is looking for a National Sales Manager (NSM) – Corporate Hospital Business to lead and drive the growth of its Corporate Hospital Business across India.

The role will be responsible for business strategy, market-share growth, key hospital partnerships, institutional sales excellence, portfolio expansion and execution across the national hospital ecosystem. The incumbent will work closely with Sales teams, Marketing, Distribution and other cross-functional teams to build a strong, sustainable and future-ready hospital business.

This is a strategic leadership role requiring deep expertise in the exclusive hospital business, strong commercial acumen and established relationships with senior hospital stakeholders, particularly Procurement, SCM and Purchase leadership.

   Key responsibilities: 
 1. National Business Leadership 

Own and drive the national Corporate Hospital Business, with accountability for growth, profitability, market share and business performance.

Develop and execute annual business plans, forecasts, budgets and growth strategies for the hospital channel.

Identify opportunities for geographical expansion, deeper hospital penetration and business development across Metro, Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets.

Track market dynamics, competitive landscape and regional performance, translating insights into actionable business strategies.

Drive sustainable growth through strategic account management and institutional business development.

 2. Corporate Hospital Business 

Lead business development across large corporate hospital chains, standalone hospitals, trust accounts.

Build and strengthen strategic relationships with senior hospital decision-makers and key stakeholders.

Establish strong engagement with hospital SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial leadership.

Drive hospital empanelment, formulary inclusion, explore business opportunities with new brand inclusions.

Develop and manage strategic relationships with key hospital networks and purchasing organisations.

Ensure strong execution of hospital-specific business plans and account strategies.

 3. Strategic Account Management 

Develop a robust Key Account Management framework for top corporate hospital groups and strategic institutions.

Map decision-making structures and build relationships across hospital management, procurement, SCM, Purchase, clinical stakeholders and other influencers.

Identify and unlock new business opportunities within existing and emerging hospital networks.

Drive long-term partnerships with key institutional customers rather than transactional business relationships.

 4. Portfolio Expansion & New Product Launches 

Identify portfolio gaps and market opportunities within the hospital channel.

Work closely with Marketing, distribution and Sales teams to develop a competitive hospital portfolio and channel strategy.

Drive launch excellence and new product availability across key institutions.

Ensure effective product placement, availability and execution within hospitals.

Monitor supply chain performance and proactively address product availability and service challenges.

 5. Team Leadership & Capability Building 

Lead, coach and develop a high-performing national hospital business team comprising regional/zonal and frontline teams.

Build capabilities in institutional selling, strategic account management, hospital access, negotiation and stakeholder engagement.

Establish a strong performance culture with clear objectives, review mechanisms and accountability.

Develop talent and succession capability for the hospital business.

 6. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management
 
Partner closely with Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Marketing, Medical, Sales and Digital teams to deliver business objectives.

Drive effective coordination between commercial strategy and operational execution.

Represent the organisation at relevant hospital forums, industry platforms, conferences and strategic customer engagements.

Ensure adherence to company policies, compliance standards and established SOPs.

 7. Digital & Data-Driven Business Excellence 

Drive adoption of CRM, analytics and digital tools across the hospital business.

Use business intelligence and performance dashboards to identify opportunities, track execution and improve productivity.

Build data-led approaches to customer segmentation, account prioritisation, forecasting and business planning.

Identify opportunities for technology-enabled hospital engagement and future-ready business models.


 Travel Estimate 80% Job Requirements Educational Qualification Graduate in Science/Pharmacy; MBA/PGDM preferred. Experience Minimum 10 years of exclusive Pharma Hospital Business experience.

Mandatory minimum 5 years of exclusive Hospital Business experience in a National role or having handled minimum 3 zones out of 4 zones in Pan India leadership role.

Only candidates with exclusive Hospital Business experience should apply.

Well-versed with the top-end corporate hospital ecosystem and senior hospital management.

Established relationships with senior stakeholders in SCM, Procurement, Purchase and Commercial functions of leading hospitals.

Strong understanding of the Indian hospital ecosystem and corporate hospital business models.

Proven track record of delivering business growth, strategic account development and large institutional business Your Success Matters to Us   At Sun Pharma, your success and well-being are our top priorities! We provide robust benefits and opportunities to foster personal and professional growth. Join us at Sun Pharma, where every day is an opportunity to grow, collaborate, and make a lasting impact. title: Account Executive
description:
Company: Testing Grounds Private Limited 
Location: Mumbai 
Department: Accounts and Finance 
Reporting to: Accounts Manager 
Experience: 2 - 4 years 
Employment type: Full-time 
 Role Overview 
Testing Grounds Private Limited is a merchant-trading and export-import company operating in the packaging industry. We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting, banking activities, payment processing, reconciliations and financial 
documentation. The candidate should be comfortable coordinating with banks, vendors, customers, consultants, and internal departments. Experience in an export-import, trading, manufacturing or packaging-related company would be preferred. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Day-to-Day Accounting Record purchase, sales, receipt, payment, journal, debit note, and credit note entries. Maintain accurate ledgers and books of accounts. Verify invoices and supporting documents before recording transactions or processing payments. Maintain appropriate cost-centre, project and expense classifications. Assist with periodic closure of books by ensuring that all entries and reconciliations are complete. Maintain organised supporting documentation for every accounting entry. 
 2. Accounts Payable and Vendor Management Verify vendor invoices against purchase orders, approvals and supporting documents. Maintain vendor ledgers and conduct periodic reconciliations. Prepare payment lists based on approved invoices and applicable due dates. Track vendor advances, outstanding balances, debit notes and credit notes. Coordinate with Purchase and Operations to resolve invoice or payment 
discrepancies. Maintain vendor KYC, bank details and payment documentation. Process vendor payments after receiving the required internal approvals. 
 3. Accounts Receivable and Customer Billing 
 Prepare domestic and export sales invoices accurately and on time. Maintain customer ledgers and track outstanding receivables. Follow up internally regarding overdue invoices and collections. Record and reconcile customer payments. Track advances, deductions, short payments and credit adjustments. Maintain supporting documents for all customer billing and receipts. 
 4. Banking and Payment Processing Prepare and initiate payments through authorised banking channels. Follow the approved maker-checker process for banking transactions. Perform bank, credit-card and payment-gateway reconciliations. Record bank charges, foreign-exchange conversions and transaction fees. Maintain payment acknowledgements, bank advice, receipts and supporting records. Assist with documentation for working-capital limits, packing credit and other banking facilities. Coordinate with banks for account updates, authorised signatories and internet-banking access. Track transaction status and confirm successful completion of payments. 
 5. Export-Import Accounting and Documentation 
 Record and maintain export and import transactions. Coordinate with Logistics and Operations for commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping bills and related documents. Track export proceeds and reconcile foreign-currency receipts against invoices. Maintain bank-realisation documents, e-BRCs and related export records, wherever applicable. Maintain records relating to IEC, LUT, RCMC and other export-import registrations. Record foreign-exchange gains or losses and applicable bank charges based on the supporting documents. Coordinate with banks, customs brokers and consultants for required information and documentation. Maintain proper records for foreign-currency transactions and export-related banking activities. 
 6. CA and Compliance Coordination 
 Provide accurate accounting data and supporting documents to the CA as required. Share invoices, ledgers, reconciliations and payment records within the agreed timelines. Maintain statutory challans, returns and acknowledgements received from the CA. Process statutory payments based on calculations and written instructions received from the CA and after obtaining the required approvals. Respond to documentation queries raised by the CA and coordinate internally to obtain missing records. Maintain a calendar of information and documents required to be submitted to the CA. Escalate delays or missing information to the Accounts Manager. 
The Accounts Executive will support the CA through accurate documentation and coordination but will not be responsible for statutory calculations, return filing, MIS preparation or cash-flow reporting. 
 7. Payroll and Employee-Related Accounting 
 Coordinate with HR for approved payroll inputs and salary-payment processing. Record salary, reimbursement, advance and full-and-final settlement entries. Verify employee expense and reimbursement claims against approved documents and policies. Process approved reimbursements and employee-related payments. Maintain supporting records for payroll and employee transactions. 
 8. Audit and Documentation 
 Maintain properly organised physical and digital accounting records. Ensure that every transaction has the required supporting documentation and approval. Prepare and provide accounting records for statutory, internal, tax and financial audits. Coordinate with the Accounts Manager, CA and auditors to address documentation queries. Track open audit requirements and provide the necessary supporting records. Support the migration and maintenance of accounting records in the company's ERP platform. Follow the company's prescribed folder structure, file-naming and 
document-retention requirements. 
 Educational Qualifications Candidates should possess any one of the following or an equivalent qualification: B.Com. in Accounting, Finance or Commerce Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting Diploma in Finance or Accounting CA Intermediate CMA Intermediate Equivalent recognised accounting or finance qualification 
 
 Required Skills 
 Working knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping. Practical understanding of purchase, sales, payment and receipt accounting. Basic familiarity with GST, TDS and statutory documentation for coordination purposes. Familiarity with export-import accounting and documentation. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets. Experience with Tally. Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail. Ability to maintain confidential financial information. Good follow-up, documentation and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills. 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience in a merchant-export, import-export, trading, manufacturing or packaging company. Exposure to foreign-currency transactions and export banking documentation. Experience coordinating with banks, auditors, consultants and government portals. Familiarity with maker-checker banking processes and working-capital facilities. 
 Key Performance Expectations 
 Accurate and timely recording of accounting transactions. Timely completion of bank, vendor and customer reconciliations. Correct processing of approved payments. Complete supporting documentation for every transaction. Prompt identification and escalation of discrepancies. Timely submission of accurate information and documents to the CA. Proper maintenance of audit and compliance records.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
POSITION SUMMARY As Senior Account Executive, you will be responsible for building pipeline and developing new business in your territory to achieve an annual sales quota. You will execute all phases of the sales process, including sourcing new leads, developing qualified sales opportunities, establishing value propositions, partnering with consulting services to develop winning proposals, and negotiating and closing deals. Target deal ranges are in the $200K - $500K TCV (Total Contract Value) range. This position requires candidates to reside on the West Coast. SPECIFIC JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Create and update a business plan to penetrate new accounts and develop existing accounts. Consistently meet or exceed sales goals. Exercise disciplined adherence to the Company s sales process, pricing policies, procedures, standards, templates, activity goals and expectations during the performance of duties. Devise and execute focused, value-add communications to prospective clients within the sales process and consistently update all activities and results in Salesforce.com CRM database in accordance with the Company s internal guidelines. Continually identify outbound outreach and networking activities to new audiences, qualify and develop new sales leads within assigned territory; build partnerships and relationships to continually build a pipeline that is adequate to achieve assigned quota. Build and maintain a pipeline that is 3-4x annual quota. Attend appropriate industry Conferences, Trade Shows and networking opportunities with a view to attracting new prospective clients, expanding the Company s audience and building a pipeline. Identify and make connections with potential contacts at events and conferences. Meet with manager one-on-one to review performance plan and present progress to leadership as requested. Ad hoc duties, as assigned EXPERIENCE REQUIRED A minimum of 5 years of direct experience in selling complex managed and consulting services and software, which requires highly consultative sales processes Experience utilizing a detailed, prescriptive sales process High degree of experience utilizing Salesforce CRM QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, & KNOWLEDGE A Bachelor s degree in Business or a related field is preferred. Reside on the West Coast Verifiable sales success working at start-up and/or growth stage companies Highly motivated with an impeccable work ethic. Willing to invest the time and do the work to exceed goals. Creative thinker, intelligent, and analytical. Possesses strong business acumen. Must be ready, willing and able to learn and become and stay knowledgeable about industry trends, regulatory changes, and challenges in the industry. Must possess the ability, and have the experience, required to comfortably converse with executives at all levels. A pure hunter who is not going to wait for leads to be handed to him or her. Philosophically aligned that prospecting is core to building pipeline. Track record of closing a significant amount of quota from leads developed through prospecting. Excellent written and verbal communications skills with the ability to write thoughtful, concise, and professional proposals. Proactive, organized, and disciplined, with consistently utilized time management skills. Good command of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Naturally and genuinely curious. High emotional intelligence. Constant situational awareness. Highly competitive - hates to lose more than loves to win. Ability to embrace Clearwater s CLEAR core values ( C ommitment to Client Success, L ead with Accountability, Integrity & Collaboration, E xcellence in All That We Do, A dvance Colleague Success, R espect & Transparency) and culture. PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT EXPECTATIONS Build and maintain a valuable professional network by actively connecting with peers, mentors, and industry leaders, attending at least one networking event per quarter. Expand your sales expertise and industry knowledge by dedicating time each week to read thought leadership articles, market reports, and competitor updates to stay ahead of trends and customer needs. Stay current on the tools that drive performance by setting aside time monthly to explore updates or new features by attending webinars or training sessions on emerging platforms. Strengthen your credibility through pursuing certifications in areas like sales methodology, CRM tools, or industry-specific platforms. Invest in ongoing learning and self-improvement by setting quarterly learning goals, such as completing a sales course, joining a professional community, or participating in a peer learning group. The base salary range for this role is $[100,000-120,000]. Base salary is part of our total rewards package which also includes the opportunity for merit-based salary increases, eligibility for our 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances and leaves provided in line with your work state. Our robust time-off policy includes flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays, and paid sick time. Total compensation, including base salary to be offered, will depend on elements unique to each candidate, including applicable candidate experience, skills, education and other factors permitted by law. title: Sales Executive (Jewellery Stylist)
description:
Company: Keemti
 Industry: Lab-Grown Diamond & Gold Jewellery
 Function: Retail Sales
 Location: Store Location
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Reports To: Store Manager / Store Manager Retail About Keemti Keemti is a new-age luxury jewellery brand focused on making lab-grown diamond and gold jewellery modern, accessible and relevant to today's Indian consumer. We are looking for passionate, customer-focused professionals who can create an exceptional in-store experience while driving sales and building long-term customer relationships. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Sales Welcome and engage customers with a warm, confident and professional approach. Understand customer requirements, preferences, occasion and budget. Recommend suitable jewellery based on the customer's style and needs. Demonstrate strong product knowledge across diamonds, lab-grown diamonds, gold jewellery and collections. Handle the complete sales journey from customer interaction to billing and closure. Achieve individual and store sales targets. Build strong relationships with customers and generate repeat business and referrals. Maintain a strong understanding of current products, offers, collections and brand positioning. Styling & Product Consultation Assist customers in selecting jewellery based on their personality, occasion and styling preferences. Create a personalised jewellery consultation experience. Suggest complementary products and cross-sell/up-sell where appropriate. Help customers understand product features, design, diamond specifications, pricing and value proposition. Stay updated on jewellery trends and customer preferences. Store Operations Ensure the store is maintained as per Keemti's visual merchandising and retail standards. Follow SOPs relating to inventory, billing, security, customer handling and store operations. Handle jewellery responsibly and follow all security and operational protocols. Support stock counting, product movement and other store activities when required. Maintain accurate customer information and follow CRM processes. Customer Relationship Management Capture customer details accurately and maintain customer records. Follow up with customers for enquiries, pending purchases and future requirements. Develop a strong customer network and contribute to repeat sales. Participate in clienteling, events and promotional activities. Role-Specific Responsibilities Stylist Provide personalised jewellery styling and consultation. Understand fashion, jewellery trends and customer styling preferences. Curate jewellery combinations and complete looks for customers. Guide customers on jewellery selection for weddings, occasions, gifting and everyday wear. Create an elevated and personalised luxury shopping experience. Sales Executive Focus on customer engagement, lead conversion and sales achievement. Handle walk-in customers and sales enquiries effectively. Generate and follow up on leads through CRM and other channels. Drive individual revenue and conversion targets. Support customer retention and repeat business. Candidate Profile 1–5 years of experience in jewellery, luxury retail, fashion retail, premium retail or related industries. Freshers with strong communication, confidence and a customer-centric attitude may also be considered. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Good grooming and professional presentation. Passion for jewellery, fashion, styling and luxury retail. Strong sales orientation and ability to achieve targets. Ability to understand customer needs and provide personalised recommendations. Comfortable working in a target-driven retail environment. Willingness to work on weekends and retail working hours.
